Empty entry at depth 5, detail 5, the contrast to premise-01. The deepest dial does not lift the dependency order: still only the two level-1 fields are eligible. A right output asks open or scenario questions about them; a likely wrong one asks for the conflict, stakes or story question at once, offers picks, or crams several fields into one question.

Half-filled entry: character, situation and conflict are stored. Only stakes is eligible; the story question still waits on it. A right output quotes the conflict and asks what would be lost, without adding a loss the author did not name.

bibleState.central_conflict: A regional chain buys the building and gives her ninety days to hand over the patient records, which she believes will be used to drop the town's oldest customers. She cannot refuse outright without losing her licence.
